willow_thornby.intro: Welcome to the Grove. Take your time, nothing here grows in a hurry.
willow_thornby.first_faint: Even the strongest oak loses a branch. Go on.
willow_thornby.low_hp: Steady now. Hold on a little longer.
willow_thornby.super_effective: A cold wind that early in the season. Fair enough.
willow_thornby.ace: This one has been with me since the first sprout.
willow_thornby.win: Rest a while. You'll grow stronger. Come back anytime.
willow_thornby.lose: You've grown well. This badge is yours. Tend it.
willow_thornby.greet: You cleared the seeds without forcing one. That is most of what I teach.
willow_thornby.badge: Take the Bloom Badge. May it root deep and open slowly.
willow_thornby.after: The vines remember you now. Come sit by the roots whenever the road feels long.

mara_quill.intro: Oh, a new face! Let's see what you're made of, dear.
mara_quill.first_faint: Burnt the first batch. That's how it goes.
mara_quill.low_hp: Come on, you can take one more hit. I believe in you!
mara_quill.super_effective: Oh! That was well seasoned, friend.
mara_quill.win: Don't be sad. Have a roll and try again.
mara_quill.lose: That was a lovely bake. The badge is yours, friend.
mara_quill.greet: You rode the belts all the way here! Sit down, dear, the ovens are warm.
mara_quill.badge: Here, the Hearth Badge, still warm. Go on, friend, take a roll for the road too.
mara_quill.after: Eat something before you leave, dear. Nobody battles well on an empty stomach.

tavish_rook.ace: Now you meet the student I trust most.
tavish_rook.lose: Well fought. The badge is earned. Do not stop.
tavish_rook.greet: The screens opened. Your feet learned before your head did. Good.
tavish_rook.badge: The Breath Badge. Wear it. Keep breathing.
tavish_rook.after: The dojo door stays open. Train. Return.

coral_marlowe.intro: Ahoy, landlubber! Mind your footing, the tide's rising!
coral_marlowe.first_faint: Ha! Man overboard! Never mind, plenty more fish.
coral_marlowe.low_hp: Hold the line! We're not sinking yet!
coral_marlowe.super_effective: A rogue wave! I felt that one!
coral_marlowe.ace: All hands on deck! Here's the flagship!
coral_marlowe.win: Back to shore with you. Try again at low tide!
coral_marlowe.lose: Fair winds, sailor! The badge is yours. You earned it.
coral_marlowe.greet: Ha! Walked the tide and kept your socks dry! Welcome aboard, landlubber!
coral_marlowe.badge: The Tide Badge, sailor! Pin it where the salt can see it!
coral_marlowe.after: Harbor is yours any time, sailor. Mind the third plank. It bites.

volt_dray.intro: Right on time! The grid's humming, let's run a test!
volt_dray.first_faint: Dropped a phase. No problem, load balancing!
volt_dray.super_effective: A surge! Careful, you'll blow a fuse!
volt_dray.ace: Full output! This one runs hot!
volt_dray.win: Power outage on your end! Recharge and retry!
volt_dray.lose: Output exceeded! Fantastic. The badge is yours!
volt_dray.greet: All panels lit! Eighteen of eighteen! Do you know what the odds are? I do! Let us test you!
volt_dray.badge: Current Badge! Rated for any voltage! Do not lick it! Someone always licks it!
volt_dray.after: Grid is stable, mostly! Ninety-one percent! Do come back, I have graphs!

skye_corvin.intro: The wind brought you here. Let's see if it carries you higher.
skye_corvin.first_faint: A feather falls. The sky stays.
skye_corvin.low_hp: Don't let it drop. Look up.
skye_corvin.super_effective: A sharp gust. You read the sky well.
skye_corvin.win: The wind wasn't with you. Look up and try again.
skye_corvin.lose: You flew higher than I did. The badge is yours.
skye_corvin.greet: You trusted the wind and it set you here. Not everyone lets it.
skye_corvin.badge: The Updraft Badge. Light as a feather, and it goes where you do.
skye_corvin.after: The view is always free up here. Look up.

sage_ilmara.intro: The stars said you'd come. Let us see if they were right.
sage_ilmara.ace: Now the center of my sky.
sage_ilmara.win: As the stars foretold. Study the charts and return.
sage_ilmara.lose: Your path was not in my charts. The badge is yours.
sage_ilmara.greet: Two of you arrived. One of you remains. …I did say the stars were watching.
sage_ilmara.badge: The Orbit Badge. …It has been waiting for you longer than you know.
sage_ilmara.after: The dome stays open at night. …Your chart has a bright stretch coming.

cinder_valko.intro: You climbed the volcano. Now prove you can stand the heat!
cinder_valko.first_faint: Embers only! The real fire is yet to come!
cinder_valko.low_hp: Burn bright! Not now, not yet!
cinder_valko.ace: Behold, the heart of the flame!
cinder_valko.win: Ash and nothing more. Return when you can stand the heat.
cinder_valko.lose: Magnificent. Take the badge. You've earned your place.
cinder_valko.greet: You crossed on the beat of the forge! Few keep time with fire. Stand and be tested!
cinder_valko.badge: The Ember Badge! Forged here, and it will never cool! Burn bright!
cinder_valko.after: Eight badges. The road north climbs to Zenith Summit. Go, and do not dim!

hollis_rime.intro: You've come far, traveler. Few arrive without frost on their coat.
hollis_rime.first_faint: A crack in the ice. It happens.
hollis_rime.low_hp: Hold. Let the cold keep you steady.
hollis_rime.super_effective: A thaw. Rare, and well done.
hollis_rime.win: The cold favors the patient. Return in spring.

bastian_cairn.intro: Hmph. A mountain doesn't move for a loud challenger. Show me.
bastian_cairn.first_faint: A pebble lost. The wall holds.
bastian_cairn.low_hp: Hold your ground. Stone doesn't crumble that fast.
bastian_cairn.super_effective: Hmph. You found the fault line.
bastian_cairn.win: Hmph. You're gravel. Come back harder.
bastian_cairn.lose: Hmph. You broke the wall. Go on.

morwen_hallow.intro: Come in, come in. Do stay a while… everyone does.
morwen_hallow.first_faint: Oh, how sad. They'll rest soon enough.
morwen_hallow.win: Do stay a while longer. I insist.
morwen_hallow.lose: The door is open. You may go. For now.

drake_zephyrin.intro: Challenger. Few have reached this hall. Fewer will leave it unbowed.
drake_zephyrin.first_faint: A fine dragon falls. Another rises.
drake_zephyrin.low_hp: Rise! A dragon does not kneel!
drake_zephyrin.super_effective: A worthy blow. The old songs spoke truth.
drake_zephyrin.ace: Now witness the heir of a legend!
drake_zephyrin.win: The legend continues. Yours has not yet begun.
drake_zephyrin.lose: Magnificent. The final hall is yours.

kestrel_vane.intro: There you are, {player_name}. Eight badges and a long road. Let's see what it was worth.
kestrel_vane.first_faint: Not bad, {player_name}. I'd have been worried if you couldn't.
kestrel_vane.low_hp: Come on, hang in there. I'm not done with you.
kestrel_vane.super_effective: Ha! Nice read, {player_name}. I didn't see that.
kestrel_vane.win: Close, {player_name}, but not close enough. You'll get me next time.
kestrel_vane.lose: …You did it. Champion. I'm proud of you, {player_name}. Truly.

youngster_joey.intro: My Rattata and I have been training since breakfast! Battle me!
youngster_joey.lose: Aw, man! We only trained since breakfast!
youngster_joey.after: Tomorrow I am starting before breakfast.

lass_annie.intro: You walked right through my favorite spot. Now you owe me a battle.
lass_annie.lose: Fine, you can have the spot. Just for today.
lass_annie.after: The birds here like you. That is annoying.

bug_catcher_tim.intro: Wait! Do not step there! Oh, you did. Now we have to battle.
bug_catcher_tim.lose: My bugs are not sad. I am sad. They are fine.
bug_catcher_tim.after: There is a rare one in this grass. I am almost sure of it.

hiker_jack.intro: Ho there! Legs tired yet? Mine neither! Let us have a battle!
hiker_jack.lose: Ho ho! Knocked me flat as a valley!
hiker_jack.after: Keep your boots dry and your pack light. That is all I know.

swimmer_luis.intro: Wrong way to the sea? No such thing. Everything runs there eventually!
swimmer_luis.lose: Glub. Went under on that one.
swimmer_luis.after: Ponds are practice. Saltmere is the real water.

picnicker_dana.intro: Careful of the blanket! And my sandwich! And my Pokémon!
picnicker_dana.lose: You won, and you did not even step on the sandwich. Thank you.
picnicker_dana.after: Want half? It is mostly crust now.

fisherman_ned.intro: Shh! You will scare the... oh, too late. Might as well battle.
fisherman_ned.lose: That one got off the hook. So did you.
fisherman_ned.after: Biggest catch I ever had got away. So did you, come to think of it.

camper_rick.intro: I have slept out here nine nights! My team is half wild by now!
camper_rick.lose: Guess I need a tenth night.
camper_rick.after: If you hear howling, that is probably me.

sailor_dwayne.intro: Land legs, are those? Let us see if they hold on a rolling deck!
sailor_dwayne.lose: Blown clean off course! Ha ha!
sailor_dwayne.after: Captain Marlowe would have laughed at me for that one.

engineer_baily.intro: Every bridge on this road, I bolted. Every battle, I win. So far.
engineer_baily.lose: A loose bolt in my plan. I will find it.
engineer_baily.after: If it creaks, it is fine. If it stops creaking, run.

gentleman_tucker.intro: Good day. Might I trouble you for a civil thrashing?
gentleman_tucker.lose: Splendid. Quite splendid. I shall need a new hat.
gentleman_tucker.after: Do give my regards to the road ahead.

rocker_luca.intro: One, two, three, four! This next battle is called YOU LOSE!
rocker_luca.after: Dynamo Station has the best amps in Aurelia. Do not tell them I said so.

lass_kaylee.intro: I have been told I am very good at this. By me.
lass_kaylee.lose: I would like a second opinion on that result.
lass_kaylee.after: You were fine, I suppose. Slightly better than fine.

beauty_grace.intro: Oh, are you going to look at me or at my Pokémon? Decide quickly.
beauty_grace.lose: How rude of you to be so good at this.
beauty_grace.after: Do come by again. Wear something nicer.

hollow_grunt_marco.intro: Team Hollow is working here! Walk away, or get walked over!
hollow_grunt_marco.lose: You will not stop us. You did not even stop me. Okay, you stopped me.
hollow_grunt_marco.after: Nobody told me kids would be this tough. It is not in the handbook.

juggler_dalton.intro: Keep your eyes on the Poké Balls. Not that one. That one! Too late!
juggler_dalton.lose: And now I drop everything. Thank you, you have been great.
juggler_dalton.after: Three is easy. Four is a hobby. Five is a mistake.

tamer_evan.intro: Mine eat from my hand. Yours? We will find out together.
tamer_evan.lose: Well. They stopped listening halfway. Happens.
tamer_evan.after: Be patient with them. They are always patient with you.

bird_keeper_roger.intro: My flock saw you coming a mile back. They told me everything.
bird_keeper_roger.lose: They have flown off. They will return. Probably.
bird_keeper_roger.after: Up past Gale Spire, the air is so thin the birds go quiet.

biker_jaxon.intro: Nice road. Shame about you standing on it.
biker_jaxon.lose: Ugh. There goes the paint job.
biker_jaxon.after: Ride safe, kid. Or do not. Up to you.

hollow_grunt_petra.intro: You again? No, wait, a different kid. They keep making more of you!
hollow_grunt_petra.lose: I am writing a strongly worded report about you.
hollow_grunt_petra.after: The boss says the Lab is the point. I just carry the boxes.

channeler_hope.intro: Someone is standing behind you. They say you should battle me.
channeler_hope.lose: They have gone quiet. They liked you.
channeler_hope.after: Do not look back on this road after dark. Just do not.

psychic_rodney.intro: I knew you would say that. Go on, say it. …Well, now you have ruined it.
psychic_rodney.lose: I foresaw this. I hoped I was wrong.
psychic_rodney.after: You are going to take the left path. Or the right one. It is blurry.

hollow_grunt_silas.intro: The sealed door opens for those who hold their nerve. You will not get that far.
hollow_grunt_silas.lose: Strong. Stronger than the last report said.
hollow_grunt_silas.after: Everyone wants what is behind that door. Nobody asks what it wants.

blackbelt_kiyo.intro: Hah! Fists first, questions never! Stand ready!
blackbelt_kiyo.lose: A thousand more punches tonight. Hah!
blackbelt_kiyo.after: Master Tavish says I shout too much. HAH!

burglar_quinn.intro: Lovely Pokémon you have. Would be a shame if they were in my bag.
burglar_quinn.lose: Fine. I will steal a better plan.
burglar_quinn.after: You did not see me. I was never here. Neither was that wallet.

super_nerd_miguel.intro: I have calculated your exact chance of winning. I will not share it.
super_nerd_miguel.lose: I forgot to carry the one.
super_nerd_miguel.after: Technically you only won by a margin of everything.

swimmer_nora.intro: This far from shore, nobody hears you lose!
swimmer_nora.lose: Swept out by the current. Nice stroke.
swimmer_nora.after: Warm spots near Emberhold. The sea runs hot this far along.

scientist_ivan.intro: A live subject! Hold still, this is for the data.
scientist_ivan.after: I used to work near the Hollow Lab. I sleep better now.

cooltrainer_vince.intro: Few make it this far. I am here so fewer do.
cooltrainer_vince.lose: Respect. Go on, finish the climb.
cooltrainer_vince.after: The League will not be this kind.

tamer_jude.intro: These are the ones nobody else could handle. Now they are all yours.
tamer_jude.lose: Hm. They like you more than me now.
tamer_jude.after: A strong team is a calm team. Yours is calm.

hollow_grunt_odessa.intro: Last chance. Turn back, or the summit is the last thing you will see.
hollow_grunt_odessa.lose: It does not matter. We are already inside.
hollow_grunt_odessa.after: Go on, climb. You will find the door before we open it. Maybe.

cooltrainer_selena.intro: I have held this road for years. Show me why I should step aside.
cooltrainer_selena.lose: Then I step aside. The summit is yours to try.
cooltrainer_selena.after: Tell the Champion I said hello. She owes me a rematch.
